throughline.en: Malaysia's data-center plans, Indonesian facility openings and Vietnam's chip-testing trial distinguish announced investment, completed facilities and unverified design capacity.

title.zh: Google 宣布 2027 至 2028 年在馬來西亞投資 150 億美元，擴建資料中心
title.en: Google announces US$15B Malaysia investment for 2027–28 data centers

summary.zh: Google 於 11 月 4 日在吉隆坡宣布，計畫於 2027 至 2028 年在馬來西亞投資 150 億美元，擴充資料中心、潔淨能源及水資源設施。新園區規劃位於雪蘭莪與森美蘭；Google 另稱將協助電網新增逾 1GW 潔淨能源，相關數值均屬承諾或預測。
summary.en: Google announced on November 4 in Kuala Lumpur that it plans to invest US$15 billion in Malaysia in 2027–28, covering data centers, clean energy and water infrastructure. New campuses are planned in Selangor and Negeri Sembilan; Google also targets more than 1GW of additional clean-energy capacity on the grid, with amounts and impacts remaining company plans or projections.

text.zh: Google 表示，現有 Elmina Business Park 園區已營運，新建案將涉及資料中心供電、散熱、配電及網路設備。這項規劃尚未列出個別園區的 IT 容量與設備採購清單。
text.en: Google says its Elmina Business Park campus is operational. The new construction encompasses data-center power, cooling, electrical distribution and network infrastructure, but individual IT-load figures and equipment procurement lists were not disclosed.

text.zh: 據路透報導，Google 估算施工期間每年平均支持逾 37,000 個工作機會，並計畫培訓約 800,000 人；這些屬公司預測或計畫，不能當成已實現成果。
text.en: Reuters attributes projected annual support for more than 37,000 jobs during construction and plans to train about 800,000 people to Google. These are estimates and commitments, not realized outcomes.

text.zh: 投資在園區、能源、水務及培訓間的正式分配、各園區動工與啟用時程、實際 IT 容量尚未逐項公布。
text.en: A project-by-project spending allocation, construction and commissioning schedules, and actual IT capacity have not been disclosed.

ceoView.en: For power-conversion and measurement suppliers, Google's plans involve electrical distribution, cooling and site power management. Campus IT loads, equipment specifications and construction schedules remain unverified, so no equipment order volume can be inferred.

title.zh: 越南 FPT 北寧封測廠開始試運轉，6 條產線設計年產能 3 億顆
title.en: FPT starts trial runs at Bac Ninh chip testing plant with six lines

summary.zh: 越南 FPT 於 11 月 3 日宣布，北寧省安豐 II-C 工業區的晶片測試與封裝廠開始試運轉，設有 6 條產線，設計年產能最高 3 億顆。現階段著重功能與可靠度測試；公司尚未公告實際出貨量或量產良率。
summary.en: Vietnam's FPT announced on November 3 that its chip testing and packaging plant in Bac Ninh's Yen Phong II-C Industrial Park has begun trial operations. Six lines have a maximum designed capacity of 300 million chips a year; shipments, mass-production yield and utilization were not disclosed.

text.zh: FPT 表示，廠內配置 ATE 自動測試機、Handler 分選設備與 ISO Class 7 無塵室，現階段進行功能及可靠度測試。設備配置與標準屬公司揭露內容，未代表已取得個別客戶產品認證。
text.en: FPT reports using automated test equipment, handlers and an ISO Class 7 cleanroom for functional and reliability testing. The disclosed systems and controls do not establish customer-product qualification.

text.zh: 3 億顆為廠房最大設計年產能，6 條為產線數，兩者都不能代表 2026 年實際測試或封裝出貨量。公司稱首批南韓夥伴測試訂單仍在安排中。
text.en: The 300 million figure is maximum annual design capacity and six is the line count; neither measures 2026 tested or packaged output. FPT says a first testing order for a South Korean partner is expected.

text.zh: 實際稼動率、已接受驗證的晶片型號、量產良率和商業出貨起始日未公布。
text.en: Utilization, qualified chip types, production yield and commercial-shipment start date are undisclosed.

title.zh: 台荷公布 4 項共同研發合作，涵蓋先進光子封裝及 3.2T 光收發模組
title.en: Taiwan and Netherlands detail four joint photonics R&D projects

summary.zh: 台灣經濟部產業發展署 11 月 4 日公布與荷蘭共同徵案的 4 項跨國研發合作，涵蓋先進光子封裝、光通訊、AI 資料中心及量子技術。合作規劃研發 3.2T 光收發模組及低損耗光纖組裝，尚未公布商用量產或客戶驗證日期。
summary.en: Taiwan's Industrial Development Administration reported four jointly selected R&D projects with the Netherlands on November 4, covering photonic packaging, communications, AI data centers and quantum technologies. Proposed work includes 3.2T optical transceivers and low-loss fiber alignment, with no commercial-production or qualification timetable disclosed.

text.zh: 先進光子封裝結合荷蘭精密光纖對位與台灣自動化組裝；AI 資料中心計畫包含高速光收發模組、異質整合與浸沒式液冷。合作屬研發及驗證階段。
text.en: Photonic packaging combines Dutch high-precision fiber alignment with Taiwan's automated assembly. The AI data-center work includes high-speed optics, heterogeneous integration and immersion cooling; it remains R&D and validation.

text.zh: 台荷代表於 11 月 2 日交流，11 月 3 日赴荷蘭恩荷芬的 PIC Summit Europe，並見證工研院、TOSIA 與 PhotonDelta 簽署合作備忘錄；11 月 4 日由台灣產發署公布。
text.en: Bilateral representatives met November 2; delegates attended PIC Summit Europe in Eindhoven on November 3, when ITRI, TOSIA and PhotonDelta signed a memorandum. Taiwan's agency released the details November 4.

text.zh: 四案預算、參與公司的個別分工、3.2T 光模組規格及客戶量產導入日未公開。
text.en: Project budgets, partner work shares, detailed 3.2T specifications and customer ramp dates remain undisclosed.

title.zh: LG CNS 在雅加達完成 30MW AI 資料中心，後續 400MW 仍屬規劃
title.en: LG CNS completes 30MW Jakarta AI data center; 400MW remains planned

summary.zh: LG CNS 於 11 月 2 日公告，印尼雅加達 30MW AI 資料中心已完工，並稱完工前已取得全數容量對應的客戶承租安排，11 月 1 日曾舉行完工典禮。公司另規劃後續階段將整體受電容量擴至 400MW，目前尚未完工。
summary.en: LG CNS announced on November 2 that a 30MW AI data center in Jakarta was completed, with a completion ceremony held November 1. The company says the initial capacity was contracted before completion, while a later expansion to 400MW of received power remains in design.

text.zh: LG CNS 表示，已建構可支援單機櫃逾 300kW 的配電系統，首階段採氣冷，未來階段才規劃加入液冷；LG 電子的空調及 LG Energy Solution 電池納入專案。
text.en: LG CNS says the facility has electrical distribution designed for racks exceeding 300kW. Phase one uses air cooling, with liquid cooling planned later; LG Electronics HVAC and LG Energy Solution batteries are integrated.

text.zh: 30MW 為此次完工設施規模，400MW 為後續整體受電容量計畫，兩者涵蓋階段與定義不同。公司未公開各階段實際 IT 負載與運轉數據。
text.en: The completed 30MW site figure and proposed 400MW total power intake refer to different phases and definitions. Phase-specific IT loads and operating data were not released.

text.zh: 實際上電與營運負載、後續液冷裝機日、400MW 擴建核准與工期尚未公布。
text.en: Actual energized load, liquid-cooling commissioning, permits and timing for the 400MW expansion remain undisclosed.

title.zh: NTT DATA 雅加達 JKT2A 資料中心啟用，提供 12MW IT 容量
title.en: NTT DATA opens JKT2A in Jakarta with 12MW of IT load

summary.zh: NTT DATA 於 11 月 3 日在雅加達宣布 JKT2A 資料中心啟用，提供 12MW IT 容量，並推出連結 JKT2、JKT2A 與 JKT3 的光子網路服務。公司列明備援供電及散熱設計，但未公布租用率。
summary.en: NTT DATA announced the opening of JKT2A in Jakarta on November 3 with 12MW of IT capacity and a photonics-based service connecting JKT2/JKT2A with JKT3. The company specified redundant power and cooling architecture but did not disclose occupancy.

text.zh: 公司公告 JKT2A 採雙變電站、2N UPS、N+1 備用發電機及空調冷卻，屬設施設計規格。JKT2 現有逾 240 家網路服務業者，JKT2A 可與其連接。
text.en: The facility is designed with dual substations, 2N UPS, N+1 generators and air-cooling infrastructure. The adjacent JKT2 interconnects with more than 240 network providers.

text.zh: 同步啟用的 APN Connect 使用全光網路連結相距約 35 公里的資料中心，以支援跨站點資料同步及備援。35 公里是站點間約略距離，並非資料中心新建容量。
text.en: APN Connect uses an all-photonics network between facilities roughly 35km apart for cross-site synchronization and resilience. The distance is a network span, not additional computing capacity.

text.zh: 承租率、開站後實際用電、客戶組合與 AI 設備配置未公布。
text.en: Occupancy, live power draw, customer mix and AI hardware deployments were not disclosed.

title.zh: 群電第三季營收 74.14 億元、淨利 1.44 億元，反映筆電與測試設備缺料
title.en: Chicony Power Q3 sales reach NT$7.414B; net profit NT$144M

summary.zh: 台灣電源供應器廠群光電能 11 月 4 日公布第三季營收新台幣 74.14 億元，年減約 18%，歸母淨利 1.44 億元，年減約 8 成。公司表示，筆電記憶體缺貨及伺服器測試設備短缺影響部分客戶拉貨時程。
summary.en: Taiwan power-supply maker Chicony Power reported Q3 revenue of NT$7.414 billion on November 4, down about 18% year on year, and parent-attributable profit of NT$144 million, down about 80%. The company cited notebook memory shortages and testing-equipment constraints that delayed some server-power customer orders.

text.zh: 第三季營收季減 12.2%，歸母淨利季減 82.3%，毛利率為 12%，較前季減少 1.1 個百分點；年增率、季增率與毛利率變化採不同比較基準，不宜混為同一成長率。
text.en: Q3 revenue declined 12.2% sequentially, parent-attributable profit fell 82.3% sequentially, and gross margin was 12%, down 1.1 percentage points quarter on quarter. The measures use distinct comparison bases.

text.zh: 公司稱筆電電源受到記憶體短缺衝擊，伺服器電源又受關鍵零件與測試設備供給限制；通訊電源需求維持。這些為公司的營運說明，未提供各產品線缺料數量。
text.en: The company attributed weaker notebook-power pull-through to memory shortages and said server-power shipments were delayed by components and test equipment. It also reported continued communications-power demand, without quantifying shortages by product.

text.zh: 伺服器電源遞延訂單金額、測試設備供應商及修復時程未公布。
text.en: The value of delayed server-power orders, affected test-equipment suppliers and recovery timing were not disclosed.

title.zh: 台電董事長稱未來十年天然氣新機組規劃約 25.98GW
title.en: Taipower chair outlines 25.98GW of planned gas-fired units over ten years

summary.zh: 台電董事長曾文生 11 月 4 日在受訪報導中表示，台電與民營電廠未來十年已規劃的天然氣新機組裝置容量合計約 25.98GW，並以現有約 39GW 用電負載說明供電計畫。此為新增機組容量規劃，尚未等同淨新增可供電量或全部工程已獲准。
summary.en: Taipower chair Tseng Wen-sheng said in an interview reported on November 4 that Taipower and independent producers plan around 25.98GW of new gas-fired nameplate capacity over ten years, compared with a current load of roughly 39GW. Planned gross unit capacity is not net deliverable power or confirmation that all projects are permitted.

text.zh: 台電表示，半導體與資料中心用電需求需同步考慮發電、輸電及特高壓設備，電源鄰近大用戶可減少長距離送電損耗。
text.en: Taipower says semiconductor and data-center power demand involves generation, transmission and extra-high-voltage equipment; proximity to generation can reduce transmission losses.

text.zh: 25.98GW 是未來十年規劃的天然氣機組裝置容量，39GW 為受訪時引用的用電負載；容量與負載不同，且未扣除機組除役、檢修或電網限制。
text.en: The 25.98GW is planned gas nameplate capacity while 39GW is cited electricity load. These are different measures, and the comparison does not net out retirements, maintenance or grid constraints.

text.zh: 各機組核准、併網日期、淨增可用容量及區域輸電限制未逐項列出。
text.en: Unit-level permits, grid connection dates, net available additions and regional transmission constraints were not detailed.

title.zh: 華新麗華等 4 家台灣企業簽約設立核能設備合資公司
title.en: Four Taiwan companies sign agreement for nuclear supply-chain venture

summary.zh: 華新麗華 11 月 3 日宣布，與世紀能源設備、高力熱處理工業及泰豐貿易簽約成立華新世紀核能系統，將整合核用材料、精密製造、銲接與熱交換技術。公司尚未公布新合資公司的資本額、訂單或核能專案核准資訊。
summary.en: Walsin Lihwa announced on November 3 that it signed an agreement with Century Energy Equipment, Kaori Heat Treatment and Tai-Feng Trading to form a nuclear-supply-chain venture. The partners cited materials, precision manufacturing, welding and heat-transfer expertise but did not disclose the venture's capital, orders or approved projects.

text.zh: 華新麗華列出不銹鋼、鎳基合金、核用管材與電纜；世紀能源設備提供重件製造及銲接；高力提供熱交換與精密製造能力，泰豐貿易協助商務聯繫。
text.en: Walsin cites stainless steel, nickel alloys, nuclear-grade tubes and cables; Century supplies heavy fabrication and welding expertise, Kaori heat exchangers and precision manufacturing, and Tai-Feng commercial services.

text.zh: 公司稱初期優先面向海外核能市場及國內既有核電設備與材料需求，並研議未來小型模組化反應器相關製造能力。簽約不代表任何特定電廠案已獲核准或開工。
text.en: The company says it will initially address overseas markets and existing domestic nuclear equipment needs, while exploring future modular-reactor manufacturing. Signing the venture does not establish approval or construction of any reactor project.

text.zh: 合資持股、資本額、核能組件認證狀態及簽約訂單尚未公開。
text.en: Equity stakes, capital, component certifications and contracted orders were not disclosed.

text.zh: Google 將前者列為 2027 至 2028 年投資計畫，後者為未來新增潔淨能源容量目標；工程進度與採購尚未逐項公布。
text.en: Google presents the first as planned 2027–28 spending and the second as a clean-energy capacity target. Project timing and procurement have not been detailed.

question.zh: 3 億顆設計產能是否代表目前出貨？
question.en: Does the 300 million capacity indicate current shipments?

text.zh: FPT 的數字為最大設計年產能，試運轉中的稼動率、量產良率與已完成訂單仍未知。
text.en: FPT states a maximum design rate; trial-stage utilization, commercial yield and completed orders remain undisclosed.

question.zh: 25.98GW 與 39GW 可以直接相減嗎？

text.zh: 前者是未來新天然氣機組的規劃裝置容量，後者是受訪時引用的用電負載；兩者定義不同，且未計除役與輸電限制。
text.en: The former is proposed new gas nameplate generation capacity; the latter is a cited electricity load. Retirements and transmission constraints are not accounted for.

text.zh: 中華經濟研究院於 11 月 2 日公布台灣 10 月製造業 PMI 為 62.5，相關數據已收錄在 11 月 3 日日報，本期僅作日期明確的背景。
text.en: Taiwan's CIER released an October manufacturing PMI of 62.5 on November 2. That statistic appears in the November 3 edition and remains dated background here.

text.zh: 部分媒體於 11 月 4 日再度報導，但公司原始財報公告日期為 10 月 30 日，未以舊財報重新入選。
text.en: Some coverage resurfaced on November 4, but the company's original results release was October 30, so the older earnings report was not republished as new.

verificationNote.zh: Google 投資由 Reuters 與 Malay Mail 引述 11 月 4 日公司公告，未取得可直接查閱的 Google 原始稿；群電與台電數據亦依媒體報導核對。金額、設計產能及長期供電規劃已分別標示狀態，尚未公開的工程時程與客戶訂單保留未確認。
verificationNote.en: Google's announcement was checked through Reuters and Malay Mail; a directly accessible Google primary release was unavailable. Chicony Power and Taipower figures were cross-checked in reporting. Planned spending, design capacity and long-term power proposals are labelled by status; project timetables and orders remain unresolved.
